clauses.requirement: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the general specifications of paragraph 5 (the requirements for lamp installation) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.

Grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps and single lamps shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 5.7 of UN R48 (heading for the rules on lamp grouping, combination and reciprocal incorporation).

Lamps (e.g. rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector in one housing) may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF; however, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other functions that can be switched ON together with it, the colour requirements of each of those other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated with one another.
Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, the conditions of paragraphs 5.7.1.3.1 and 5.7.1.3.2 shall be met.

Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.

Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
